Name: Useable Community Center
Author: fireredlily
Description:
Ever wanted to be able to use the appliances in the community center once it's fully upgraded? Now you can! This adds minor map changes to make the kitchen, sewing room, vault room, and boiler room more useful.

[b][size=4]Mod Features:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Interact with the stove in the Kitchen to craft cooking recipes using your inventory
[*]Interact with the spinning wheel in the Crafts Room to tailor clothing
[*]Interact with the Dye Pots in the Crafts Room to dye clothing (now works with SVE!)
[*]Interact with the anvil added to the Boiler Room when Clint is nearby to utilize his services while he's admiring the boiler
[*]Interact with the filing cabinet in the Vault Room to view your Farmer's file statistics
[*]Interact with the new Prize Machine added to the Vault Room to redeem your Prize Tickets.
[*](NEW!) Interact with the book on the desk in the Vault Room to use the mayor's Ledger Book to split/share wallets, and send money to other players in Split Wallet mode.
[*](NEW!) Interact with the book on the stand to the left of the vault in the Vault Room to use the mayor's Divorce Book.
[/list]
[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Confirmed compatibility with Community Center Reimagined!
[*]Compatibility with CC Reimagined Overriding SVE through config options
[*]Compatibility with SVE through config options
[*]Multiplayer compatible (all players must have this mod)
[/list]
This mod is not compatible with most mods that change the positioning of furniture in the Community Center, with the exception of those listed above. No rooms are moved as a result of this mod, so mods that add rooms without relocating the original rooms may be compatible, so long as the other mods don't replace the entire interior map.

Downloads.Description: This version adds EMA as an optional dependency and includes new features powered by EMA: the Mayor's LedgerBook, accessible on the desk in the Vault Room, and the Mayor's DivorceBook, accessible from the stand to the left of the vault.
